Hi Kajal, it's a pleasure to meet you.  Thanks for coming in today. I've reviewed your resume and am impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based inventory management system and your web-based expense tracker.  It shows a good understanding of both back-end and front-end development.

To get started, could you please tell me a little about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within software development, and what excites you about this opportunity.

Thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today. I've truly enjoyed learning more about your experience and skills, and I've gathered some valuable insights.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we'll be in touch to let you know the next steps in the hiring process within [ timeframe, e.g., one week ].  Thank you again for your interest in [Company Name]. We appreciate you considering us.
